title: AGENTS.md: a rule's provenance cites the ADR / ruling record first, the commit sha second, never a bare tracker number — and runtime strings carry no numbers (ruling batch #195 item 3 letter C+D on #19123)
body:
Filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`), executing ruling batch #195 item 3 letter C+D on #19123 (maintainer 「同意」). ⛔ Filed bare: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are triage's production. Landing: `AGENTS.md` (Tier H — draft PR, human merge) ⇒ the skills lane.

## What changes

`AGENTS.md` today says a rule's provenance lives in the PR that landed it. #19123 measured that 11.7%–15.1% of one week's merged-PR numbers are already deleted from GitHub (no 301; the commit → PR association is empty), so that convention points readers at objects this repository does not control and has measured itself destroying.

Replace that sentence with the order the ruling sets:

1. A load-bearing internal anchor cites the **ADR / ruling record** when one exists (stable, in-repo, carries the narrative).
2. Otherwise it cites the **commit sha** in this repository's history. A PR number may follow as a convenience link, ⛔ never as the citation.
3. **Runtime strings** (refusal messages, prescriptions, anything printed to an author) carry **no tracker numbers**: the lesson is written into the text — the rule `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` already enforces for every other package under the maintainer's words 「处理 issue 时犯的错应该总结成经验,保留 issue id没有意义」 (#13179).

## Acceptance

- The sentence is replaced, not appended to; no second convention survives beside it.
- The fifteen measured lines in `packages/spec` are the spec seat's (#19123 stays in that lane); this card is the convention text only.
- Enforcement reach into `packages/spec/scripts/**` is #19124, ⛔ not this card.
- `Clause-②: no`.
